transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, honestly, what made me come in is that I feel like... I don't know, the warm part of me just shut off. I'll sit with my husband after work, or try to watch my shows, and I know I should feel some comfort or even a little happy. But there’s just nothing there.
Do you still enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable?

Yeah, that's kind of what I meant about watching my shows or sitting with my husband. I used to really look forward to doing those things after being on my feet all day at work. But now... no, I don't really enjoy them. Like I said, I just don't feel anything good or happy when I do them anymore. It's just blank.
Do you feel sad most of the time?

No, I wouldn't say I feel sad. It's not like I'm crying or feeling down all the time. It's really just that blank feeling I was talking about. I'm not sad, but I'm not happy either. I'm just kind of... empty.
Do you still feel interested in doing things?

I don't know... I'm not really sure. I guess I haven't really noticed if I'm interested or not. I still get up and go to work, do my shifts stocking, and I come home and do whatever needs doing around the house. I just kind of go through the motions. So I don't know if my interest is gone, exactly... I just don't feel much about it either way.
Do you ever feel sad?
I think I just answered that... but no, not really. Like I said, it's not sadness. I'm not crying or feeling down. It's just that empty, blank feeling.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been about three weeks now. It all started right after... well, there was an accident at work. A pallet collapsed and really injured my coworker. I've just felt this way ever since that happened.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?

Not really. Honestly, that's what made me come in to see you. I feel like the warm part of me just... shut off. Like, I sit with my husband or try to watch my regular shows after work, and I know I should feel comfort, or even just a little happy to be relaxing. But there's just nothing there. I don't enjoy it, I just do it.
Have you noticed any change in your weight recently?
No, I haven't really noticed any change. My clothes still fit the same, so I think my weight has stayed pretty much what it usually is.
Do you feel anxious?
I don't think so. I mean, I haven't really noticed feeling nervous or on edge, if that's what you mean. It's mostly just been that blank feeling I was talking about.
Do you feel guilty about anything?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I haven't really done anything to feel guilty about. So, no, guilt isn't really something I'm dealing with right now.
Are there any activities, no matter how small they might seem, that you still look forward to or find some pleasure in?

Not really. Honestly, that's kind of what made me come in. I feel like the warm part of me just... shut off. I'll sit with my husband or try to watch my shows after work, and I know I should feel comfort or even just a little happy to be relaxing, but there's just nothing there right now.
Are there any small pleasures in life, like eating or taking a warm bath, that you still enjoy?

No, not even those. I mean, I eat because I have to, especially being on my feet all day at work, but I don't really care what I'm eating. It doesn't bring me any joy or taste specially good. And a hot shower is just... getting clean so I can go to bed. 

Like I was saying before, it's all just flat. I don't really feel anything good from any of it right now.
Do you feel like you've been moving more slowly than usual?

No, I wouldn't say I'm moving slower. I mean, my job at the warehouse keeps me pretty active, so I'm still moving at my normal pace, getting things stocked and all. I just don't feel anything while I'm doing it.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, I have. Most nights, I get home from my late shift and I'm just completely exhausted. I'll lie down, but every time I start to drift off, I just... jerk awake. It's like I think I hear pallets shifting or something falling at work. And even if I do manage to fall asleep, I wake up feeling like I never really rested at all.
Do you feel tired most of the time?

Not really most of the time, no. I know I just said I'm exhausted when I get off my shift, but during the actual day... I'm okay. Once I get to the warehouse and start working, I just run on autopilot. I don't feel like I'm dragging while I'm on the clock or anything. It's really just at night and when I first wake up that I feel it.
Do you feel like your thoughts are slower than they used to be?

No, I don't think so. I mean, my thoughts don't feel slow. If anything, my mind is just kind of... blank a lot of the time, like I said, just on autopilot. But when I need to think about where something goes or how many boxes I need, it comes to me just as fast as it always did. So, no, not slower.
Do you feel like you've been fidgeting or restless more than usual?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, I'm always moving around at work anyway, stocking shelves and filling orders, so I'm on my feet a lot. But when I'm actually sitting down or off the clock... no, I'm not really fidgety. I don't get that restless feeling like I need to pace or can't sit still. I usually just stay pretty still.
Do you feel worthless?

No, I don't feel worthless. I just feel... empty, I guess. But not worthless. I still know I'm doing my job and taking care of what I need to. It's just that none of it really feels like it matters right now. But no, I wouldn't use the word worthless.
Do you feel like you're putting in less effort or doing less than you used to in your daily activities?

No, I wouldn't say I'm putting in less effort or doing less. I'm still doing all my shifts at the warehouse, still getting my orders filled, still doing what I'm supposed to do. I mean, I'm just going through the motions, like I said, but the actual amount of work I'm doing hasn't changed. I'm still getting it all done.
Have you been having any thoughts about harming yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I definitely don't want to hurt myself. Like I said, things just feel kind of empty right now, but I would never do anything to actually harm myself.
